participant_level_analysis.section_4_4_summary: Table 8 reports participant-level performance on the five unseen hold-out participants. Accuracy ranged from 0.6923 to 0.8718 (unweighted mean 0.7511, SD 0.0647), indicating substantial between-participant variation in the final evaluation. These participant-level results are reported only as a post hoc stability analysis on unseen participants and were not used to select the model, tune the threshold, or adjust any hyperparameter.
